# League of Minnesota Cities

> The League of Minnesota Cities provides comprehensive governance training, financial management guides, and resources to help Minnesota municipalities operate effectively and compliantly.

LMC serves as a central knowledge hub for city officials, clerks, and administrators across Minnesota, offering training courses, how-to guides, and expert guidance on municipal governance, finance, compliance, and workforce development. The organization supports cities of all sizes with practical resources on legal requirements, budgeting, technology, and human resources.

## Key Topics

- Municipal Governance
- City Finance & Budgeting
- Property Tax & Revenues
- City Council Procedures
- Open Meetings Law
- Municipal Compliance
- Grant Funding
- City Clerk Duties
- Cybersecurity for Cities
- Human Resources Management
- Municipal Contracting
- Data Privacy
- First Amendment
- City Administration
- Workforce Recruitment

## Financial Management & Budgeting

- [Finance](https://www.lmc.org/topics/finance): Training and guides on city budgeting, property tax, and financial management
- [Fiscal Management](https://www.lmc.org/topics/fiscal-management): How-to guide on budgeting and fiscal management for small Minnesota cities
- [Revenues](https://www.lmc.org/topics/revenues): Learning resources on municipal revenues and property tax for Minnesota cities
- [Expenditures](https://www.lmc.org/topics/expenditures): Guide to municipal expenditures, budgeting, and city clerk procedures
- [Grant Navigator](https://www.lmc.org/topics/grant-navigator): Grant Navigator Program helping cities identify and apply for project funding
- [Grants Guide](https://www.lmc.org/topics/grants-guide): Comprehensive guide to finding and applying for grants for city projects

## Governance & Council Operations

- [City Council](https://www.lmc.org/topics/city-council): Learning resources on city council governance, procedures, and First Amendment issues
- [Council Meetings](https://www.lmc.org/topics/council-meetings): Training on council meeting procedures, open meetings, and meeting management
- [City Structure](https://www.lmc.org/topics/city-structure): Learning resources on local government structure and organization in Minnesota
- [Roles and Powers](https://www.lmc.org/topics/roles-and-powers): Training on municipal powers, roles, and conflict-of-interest guidelines
- [Regulations and Licensing](https://www.lmc.org/topics/regulations-and-licensing): Guide to municipal regulations, licensing, and compliance for Minnesota cities

## City Administration & Operations

- [City Administration](https://www.lmc.org/topics/city-administration): Training on city administration, cybersecurity, elections, and clerk duties
- [Roles and Duties](https://www.lmc.org/topics/roles-and-duties): Free courses on city clerk roles, duties, and municipal governance
- [Contracting](https://www.lmc.org/topics/contracting): How-to guide on municipal contracting procedures and best practices
- [Data Privacy](https://www.lmc.org/topics/data-privacy): Guide to Minnesota data privacy laws and city data practices compliance
- [Technology](https://www.lmc.org/topics/technology-city-administration): Cybersecurity training and technology guidance for city administration

## Workforce & Human Resources

- [City Career Advantage Home](https://www.lmc.org/topics/city-career-advantage): City Career Advantage program for workforce recruitment and talent retention
- [Human Resources](https://www.lmc.org/topics/human-resources): Training on HR, employee safety, diversity, and workplace culture for cities
- [Hiring](https://www.lmc.org/topics/hiring): Training and resources on recruitment and hiring for Minnesota cities

## Resources & Learning Hub

- [Resources](https://www.lmc.org/resources): Central hub for city governance resources and guidance from League of Minnesota Cities
